### 2026-11-01: FINAL ENTRY FOR WEEK 4!!!

**2h**

FINAL ENTRY FOR WEEK 4!!!
(hopefully)

So once my pcb and firmware was over, the next step was to prepare my bom and and my repo.

I created a github repo named "Keychain-project" where my files for week 4 is placed.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/amKXWkggCyjJw2xKYyfRbZCiJrdn6xQT/083ec28d6aa5df9dc9071000d63a511563c3709d624bf623f8af439308840433.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/amKXWkggCyjJw2xKYyfRbZCiJrdn6xQT/eafa96a41b92893fed84bcbc07690b1742c237698b0a1db4ea4bbe602a9799d7.png)
